title: The farm, dry stage: the empty creek bed
about: Map stages (M2). Spring 3, before the first green (farmGreen 0): farm@dry.tmj. The creek bed (x 26-27, y 3-30) is dry cracked mud with straw at its lip, the footbridge crosses at y 6, the two creek trees stand bare. The farmer stands on the west bank looking at the bed.
